count.description: Number of product units. Only applies to products of type `flat_fee`, `seat` or `credit`.

unit_name.description: Product name. This will appear on the final invoices. Only applies to products of type `seat` or `usage`.

min_committed_count.description: Minimum of units committed. If usage is less than this number, then this value will be used. Only applies to products of type `usage`.

min_amount.description: Minimum amount billed. If the final computed amount from the usage for this product is less than this amount, then this value will be used. Only applies to products of type `usage`.

max_amount.description: Maximum amount billed. If the final computed amount from the usage for this product is greater than this amount, then this value will be used. Only applies to products of type `usage`.

charging_method.description:
Charging method for seat count updates within the current billing period. Only applies to connected seat products.

- `prorata`: Price calculated proportionally to time elapsed in the billing period.
- `pay_in_full`: Price calculated for the entire billing period.
- `do_not_charge`: No charge for the update.

seat_invoicing_schedule.description:
Policy defining when seat count changes are invoiced. Only applies to connected seat products.

- `immediately`: Seat changes are invoiced immediately.
- `next_invoice`: Seat changes are invoiced at the next invoice.
- `custom`: Seat changes are invoiced on a custom schedule.

metering_interval_type.description:
Indicates on which type of interval the usage should be aggregated.

- `subscription_commitment`: For the usage contained within the subscription commitment period.
- `payment_interval`: For the usage contained within the payment interval of the product.
- `full_database`: For all the usage we ingested for this product, no matter the period.
- `phase_duration`: For the usage contained within the subscription phase.
- `custom`: For the usage contained within a custom interval that starts with the phase and renews independently of the billing interval. Requires `metering_interval` to be set.
   Only applies to products of type `usage`.

metering_interval.description: Custom interval for usage aggregation. Required when `metering_interval_type` is `custom`. The interval starts at the phase start and renews on its own cycle (e.g. `{ period: 'months', count: 3 }` for quarterly metering with monthly billing). Only applies to products of type `usage`.

bill_usage_difference.description: Only bill the usage difference comparing to the previous period (i.e. actual amount minus last invoice amount). Doesn't apply to `payment_interval` metering interval type. Only applies to products of type `usage`.

children_usage_aggregation.description:
Controls whether a parent organization's metered usage is billed on the combined usage of the parent and its direct children, and how per-member values are combined.

- `null`: Organization-based usage is disabled. Only the subscription customer's own usage is billed.
- `sum`: The usage values of the parent and each direct child are added together (organization total).
- `max`: Only the single highest-consuming member (parent or one direct child) is billed.
 Only applies to products of type `usage`. Not compatible with BPS prices.

credits_expiration_in_days.description: Validity in days for credits that will be topped-up automatically. Once the period has passed, they'll expire.

expire_credits_at_end_of_period.description: Automatically set the expiration date to the end of the next period for each topup. Takes priority on `creditsExpirationInDays`

- `forever`: Will apply the coupon to all invoices.
- `custom`: Will apply to coupon until a specified expiration date.
- `duration`: Will apply the coupon for a specific duration (e.g., 3 months).

ends_at.description: End date of the contract. UTC date time string in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

renew_automatically.description:

- `false`: The contract will not be renewed automatically.

- `immediately`: The contract will be activated immediately.
- `manual`: The contract will be activated when a user manually activates it.
- `start_date`: The contract will be activated on a specified date.
- `quote_signature`: The contract will be activated when the subscription quote is signed.
- `checkout`: The contract will be activated when the subscription checkout is completed.

end_strategy.description:
End strategy of contract.

- `manual`: The contract ends when a user manually stops it.
- `end_date`: The contract ends on a specified date.
- `duration`: The contract ends after a specific relative duration, unless `renew_automatically` is true.

starts_at.description: Applies only if the activation strategy is `start_date`. UTC date time string in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

display_shipping_details.description: Indicates if the shipping details should be displayed on the subscription's invoices.

cancel_at.description: Subscription cancel date. UTC date time string in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

cancellation_strategy.description:
Strategy used to cancel the subscription. If not specified `do_nothing` is used.

- `charge_prorata`: Will charge the customer the unpaid amount for the prorated period up to the end of the current period.
- `charge_custom`: Will charge the customer a custom amount.
- `refund_prorata`: Will refund to the customer the overpaid subscription amount using prorated calculations on the cancellation date.
- `refund_custom`: Will refund to the customer a custom amount.
- `end_of_period`: Will cancel the subscription at the end date of the current billing period.
- `do_nothing`: Will only cease the subscription without any additional actions.

- `new`: Ask the customer for a new payment method. The customer can fill in their payment method either on the subscription's checkout session or on their portal page.
- `current`: Use the current default payment method of the customer.

create_setup_phase.description: Deprecated field, no longer needed. We recommend not using it going forward.

Alignment of product billing cycles. Only applies when creating a subscription from a plan. If omitted, the billing cycles alignment configured in the account subscription settings applies.

- `calendar_period`: The billing cycles of the products will be aligned on the calendar period, after the first period which will be invoiced taking into account the prorata of the first cycle compared to the product periodicity.
- `anniversary`: The billing cycles of the products will be aligned on the anniversary of the phase initial billing date.

email.description: Email address to which we'll automatically send a message with the checkout link.

anyOf.description:
If a `template_id` or a `template_configuration_id` is specified, the subscription will be created from scratch, and the template will only be referenced for reporting purposes.

Use `From template` option to create a subscription from a template.

type.description:
Type of subscription phase.

- `setup`: The phase represents a non-recurring service setup period, often used before the actual recurring subscription begins.
- `trial`: The phase represents a non-recurring trial period, often used to allow users to opt out or experience a free test.
- `standard`: The phase represents a standard recurring billing.

status.description:
Status of subscription phase.

- `pending`: The phase is waiting to start (not started yet).
- `active`: The phase is currently in progress.
- `finished`: The phase has ended and is complete.

order.description: Order in which the phase is executed within all subscription phases.

activation_strategy.description:
Activation strategy of subscription phase.

- `immediately`: The phase starts as soon as the subscription is activated.
- `manual`: The phase starts when a user manually activates it.
- `start_date`: The phase starts on a specified date.
- `quote_signature`: The phase starts when the subscription quote is signed.
- `checkout`: The phase starts when the subscription checkout is completed.
- `contract_start_date`: The phase starts on the start date of the related subscription contract.
- `previous_phase_end`: The phase starts when the previous phase ends.

end_strategy.description:
End strategy of subscription phase.

- `manual`: The phase ends when a user manually stops it.
- `end_date`: The phase ends on a specified date.
- `duration`: The phase ends after a specific relative duration.
- `contract_end_date`: The phase ends on the end date of the related subscription contract.

duration.description: Interval over which the subscription phase spans. Only applies to `duration` end strategy.

billing_date_setting.description:
Represents when the first billing date occurs.

- `phase_start`: Aligns with the start of the phase.
- `specific_date`: Occurs on a specified date.

initial_billing_at.description: Date when the subscription phase will start being billed. Only applies to `specific_date` billing date setting. UTC date time string in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

starts_at.description: Actual start date of the phase. UTC date time string in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

ends_at.description: Actual end date of the phase. UTC date time string in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

billing_cycle_alignment.description:

- `calendar_period`: The billing cycles of the products will be aligned on the calendar period, after the first period which will be invoiced taking into account the prorata of the first cycle compared to the product periodicity.
- `anniversary`: The billing cycles of the products will be aligned on the anniversary of the phase initial billing date.

do_not_invoice_phase.description: Indicates if the phase should be invoiced. If set to true, the phase will not generate any invoices.

transition_calculation_method.description:
Calculation method used when transitioning from one phase to the next one.

- `prorata`: The prorated amount between the two phases relative to the end date (the transition date) must be paid.
- `pay_in_full`: The full amount for the phase billing period must be paid.
- `none`: No amount will need to be paid, phase will simply transition from one to the next.

transition_invoicing_schedule.description:
Represents when the transition amount will be invoiced.

- `immediately`: An invoice will be generated immediately with the corresponding amount.

- `calendar_period`: The billing cycles of the products will be aligned on the calendar period, after the first period which will be invoiced taking into account the prorata of the first cycle compared to the product periodicity.
- `anniversary`: The billing cycles of the products will be aligned on the anniversary of the phase initial billing date.

id.description: The unique identifier of the subscription transition

customer_id.description: The ID of the customer associated with the transition

base_subscription_id.description: The ID of the original subscription from which this transition is derived. It references the last active version of the subscription.

source_subscription_id.description: The ID of the subscription to transition from

target_subscription_id.description: The ID of the subscription to transition to

status.description: The current status of the subscription transition. Possible values are 'scheduled', 'completed', 'failed', and 'draft'.

transitioned_at.description: The date and time when the transition was completed. Null if the transition is not yet completed. UTC date time string in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

name.description: An optional name for the transition

transition_date.description: The date at which the transition should occur. Only applicable if the application schedule is 'scheduled'. Can be a past date within the current billing period. UTC date time string in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

application_schedule.description: When the transition should be applied: 'immediately', 'scheduled' for a specific date, or 'last_renewal' to apply it retroactively to the start of the current billing period (refunding what was already invoiced for that period and re-charging the new configuration). Past dates within the current billing period are supported and will be applied immediately.

billing_cycle_transition_method.description: The billing cycle transition method to use. 'keep_current_billing_cycle' (the default) keeps the current billing cycle dates; the request is rejected when the phases share no product billing periodicity, as the cycle cannot then be preserved — use 'align_to_new_billing_cycle' in that case. 'align_to_new_billing_cycle' aligns the billing cycle to the transition date.

calculation_method.description: The calculation method to use for the transition. 'do_not_charge' will not generate any transition invoice. 'pro_rata' will generate a prorated invoice for the remaining period. 'pro_rata_separate_documents' issues a credit note for the current period (the amount invoiced when 'last_renewal', otherwise a prorated cancellation credit) and a separate invoice for the new configuration.

type.description:
Type of subscription phase.

- `setup`: The phase represents a non-recurring service setup period, often used before the actual recurring subscription begins.
- `trial`: The phase represents a non-recurring trial period, often used to allow users to opt out or experience a free test.
- `standard`: The phase represents a standard recurring billing.

status.description:
Status of subscription phase.

- `pending`: The phase is waiting to start (not started yet).
- `active`: The phase is currently in progress.
- `finished`: The phase has ended and is complete.

order.description: Order in which the phase is executed within all subscription phases.

activation_strategy.description:
Activation strategy of subscription phase.

- `immediately`: The phase starts as soon as the subscription is activated.
- `manual`: The phase starts when a user manually activates it.
- `start_date`: The phase starts on a specified date.
- `quote_signature`: The phase starts when the subscription quote is signed.
- `checkout`: The phase starts when the subscription checkout is completed.
- `contract_start_date`: The phase starts on the start date of the related subscription contract.
- `previous_phase_end`: The phase starts when the previous phase ends.

end_strategy.description:
End strategy of subscription phase.

- `manual`: The phase ends when a user manually stops it.
- `end_date`: The phase ends on a specified date.
- `duration`: The phase ends after a specific relative duration.
- `contract_end_date`: The phase ends on the end date of the related subscription contract.

duration.description: Interval over which the subscription phase spans. Only applies to `duration` end strategy.

billing_date_setting.description:
Represents when the first billing date occurs.

- `phase_start`: Aligns with the start of the phase.
- `specific_date`: Occurs on a specified date.

initial_billing_at.description: Date when the subscription phase will start being billed. Only applies to `specific_date` billing date setting. UTC date time string in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

starts_at.description: Actual start date of the phase. UTC date time string in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

ends_at.description: Actual end date of the phase. UTC date time string in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

billing_cycle_alignment.description:
Alignment of product billing cycles. If omitted at creation, the billing cycles alignment configured in the account subscription settings applies.

- `calendar_period`: The billing cycles of the products will be aligned on the calendar period, after the first period which will be invoiced taking into account the prorata of the first cycle compared to the product periodicity.
- `anniversary`: The billing cycles of the products will be aligned on the anniversary of the phase initial billing date.

do_not_invoice_phase.description: Indicates if the phase should be invoiced. If set to true, the phase will not generate any invoices.

transition_calculation_method.description:
Calculation method used when transitioning from one phase to the next one.

- `prorata`: The prorated amount between the two phases relative to the end date (the transition date) must be paid.
- `pay_in_full`: The full amount for the phase billing period must be paid.
- `none`: No amount will need to be paid, phase will simply transition from one to the next.

transition_invoicing_schedule.description:
Represents when the transition amount will be invoiced.

- `immediately`: An invoice will be generated immediately with the corresponding amount.

- `pay_in_full`: The amount corresponds to the full payment of the tier.
- `do_not_charge`: The tier is not charged and ignored.

unit_name.description: Product name. This will appear on the final invoices. Only applies to products of type `seat` or `usage`.

min_committed_count.description: Minimum of units committed. If usage is less than this number, then this value will be used. Only applies to products of type `usage`.

min_amount.description: Minimum amount billed. If the final computed amount from the usage for this product is less than this amount, then this value will be used. Only applies to products of type `usage`.

max_amount.description: Maximum amount billed. If the final computed amount from the usage for this product is greater than this amount, then this value will be used. Only applies to products of type `usage`.

charging_method.description:
Charging method for seat count updates within the current billing period. Only applies to connected seat products.

- `prorata`: Price calculated proportionally to time elapsed in the billing period.
- `pay_in_full`: Price calculated for the entire billing period.
- `do_not_charge`: No charge for the update.

seat_invoicing_schedule.description:
Policy defining when seat count changes are invoiced. Only applies to connected seat products.

- `immediately`: Seat changes are invoiced immediately.
- `next_invoice`: Seat changes are invoiced at the next invoice.
- `custom`: Seat changes are invoiced on a custom schedule.

metering_interval_type.description:
Indicates on which type of interval the usage should be aggregated.

- `subscription_commitment`: For the usage contained within the subscription commitment period.
- `payment_interval`: For the usage contained within the payment interval of the product.
- `full_database`: For all the usage we ingested for this product, no matter the period.
- `phase_duration`: For the usage contained within the subscription phase.
- `custom`: For the usage contained within a custom interval that starts with the phase and renews independently of the billing interval. Requires `metering_interval` to be set.
   Only applies to products of type `usage`.

metering_interval.description: Custom interval for usage aggregation. Required when `metering_interval_type` is `custom`. The interval starts at the phase start and renews on its own cycle (e.g. `{ period: 'months', count: 3 }` for quarterly metering with monthly billing). Only applies to products of type `usage`.

bill_usage_difference.description: Only bill the usage difference comparing to the previous period (i.e. actual amount minus last invoice amount). Doesn't apply to `payment_interval` metering interval type. Only applies to products of type `usage`.

children_usage_aggregation.description:
Controls whether a parent organization's metered usage is billed on the combined usage of the parent and its direct children, and how per-member values are combined.

- `null`: Organization-based usage is disabled. Only the subscription customer's own usage is billed.
- `sum`: The usage values of the parent and each direct child are added together (organization total).
- `max`: Only the single highest-consuming member (parent or one direct child) is billed.
 Only applies to products of type `usage`. Not compatible with BPS prices.

If the error happened on an already authenticated transaction, the customer needs to contact their card issuer for more information.
- `payment_method_authorization_error`: A transaction authorization cannot be created for a variety of reasons such as the card issuer couldn't be reached, or the card requires a PIN.
- `payment_method_declined`: The payment method was declined for a variety of reasons such as a card reported as lost or stolen, insufficient funds or reaching the limit available on the method to complete the purchase, a payment method on a known block list, etc.
- `payment_method_expired`: The payment method is expired. The customer should go to their portal page and change their payment method.
- `payment_method_invalid`: The payment method is invalid in most cases because of incorrect details (card/account number, CVC, expiration date, postal code).
- `payment_method_not_supported`: The payment method doesn't support this type of purchase (e.g. currency, online payment).
- `declined`: The payment was declined for a variety of reasons such as security violation, banking service not available, transaction not allowed, etc.
- `fraud`: The payment provider suspected the transaction was fraudulent and has been blocked. Don't report more detailed information to your customer, and check on your provider account.
- `processing_error`: The payment couldn't be processed by the issuer for an unknown reason.
- `provider_error`: An error occurred when contacting the payment provider to initiate the transaction.
- `unknown`: A generic error happened on the payment provider side.

status.description:
Quote status.

- `draft`: The quote is a draft.
- `approved`: The quote is approved and ready to be sent to the customer.
- `pending_signature`: The quote is awaiting the customer's signature.

owner_email.description: Email address of the Hyperline user acting as the quote owner. If not specified, the Hyperline account owner will be assigned.

customer_id.description: ID of the customer.

invoicing_entity_id.description: ID of the invoicing entity attached to the quote.

comments.description: Custom comments displayed on the quote.
comments.example: Please find the contract and subscription details we discussed.

terms.example: By signing this quote, you accept our conditions of use for the use of our products and services.

amount.description: Estimated contract value. For subscription quotes, defaults to the computed subscription value if not specified. For one-off quotes, this field is ignored — the amount is always derived from the linked invoice's `amount_excluding_tax`.

collect_payment_details.description: Collect customer payment method mandate during signature flow or not.

collect_custom_property_ids.description: IDs of the customer custom properties required to be filled during the signature flow.

contract_clause_ids.description: IDs of the contract clauses used in the quote terms.

require_tax_id.description: Require the customer to provide a tax ID during the signature flow.

display_quote_value.description: Display the total quote value on the quote.

display_quote_value_with_tax.description: Display the total quote value including tax on the quote. Only applies to `one_off` quotes.

display_taxes.description: Display tax breakdown on the quote.

display_price_tiers.description:
Controls which price tiers are displayed on the quote.

- `all`: Display all pricing tiers.
- `matching`: Only display the tiers used to compute the price based on quantity.
- `none`: Hide all pricing tiers.

display_phase_value.description: Display per-phase value breakdown on the quote.

display_first_invoice_amount.description: Display the first invoice amount on the quote.

display_documents_in_preview.description: Display attached documents in the quote preview.

display_subscription_on_update.description: Display subscription details on subscription update quotes.

generate_draft_invoices.description: When `true`, the invoice issued after signature stays in `draft` status instead of being emitted for payment. Use this when you want to review the final invoice manually before sending it. Defaults to `false`.

automatically_start_subscription.description: Deprecated field, please use the phase activation strategy `quote_signature` instead.

template_id.description: ID of the quote template. If not specified, a subscription configuration or an `invoice` payload must be defined.

expires_at.description: Quote expiration date. UTC date time string in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

invoicing_entity_id.description: ID of the invoicing entity attached to the subscription. If not defined, fallback to customer's invoicing entity.

crm_opportunity_id.description: ID of the related opportunity/deal in the connected CRM.

commitment_interval.description: Deprecated field, please use `contract_terms`.

renew_automatically.description: Deprecated field, please use `contract_terms`.

minimum_invoice_fee.description: Minimum fee applied to each invoice outside of one time payments.

starts_at.description: Start date of the contract. UTC date time string in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

ends_at.description: End date of the contract. UTC date time string in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

duration.description: Interval over which the contract initially spans. Only applies to `duration` end strategy.

renew_automatically.description:
Indicates if the contract should be renewed automatically.

- `true`: The contract will be renewed automatically.
- `false`: The contract will not be renewed automatically.

renew_for_duration.description: Interval over which the contract will be renewed. Only applies if `renew_automatically` is true.

activation_strategy.description:
Activation strategy of the contract.

- `immediately`: The contract will be activated immediately.
- `manual`: The contract will be activated when a user manually activates it.
- `start_date`: The contract will be activated on a specified date.
- `quote_signature`: The contract will be activated when the subscription quote is signed.
- `checkout`: The contract will be activated when the subscription checkout is completed.

end_strategy.description:
End strategy of contract.

- `manual`: The contract ends when a user manually stops it.
- `end_date`: The contract ends on a specified date.
- `duration`: The contract ends after a specific relative duration, unless `renew_automatically` is true.

contract_terms.description: Contract terms linked to the subscription.

starts_at.description: Applies only if the activation strategy is `start_date`. UTC date time string in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

initial_billing_at.description: Date when the subscription will start being billed. If not specified, it will correspond to the `starts_at` date. UTC date time string in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

display_shipping_details.description: Indicates if the shipping details should be displayed on the subscription's invoices.

cancel_at.description: Subscription cancel date. UTC date time string in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

cancellation_strategy.description:
Strategy used to cancel the subscription. If not specified `do_nothing` is used.

- `charge_prorata`: Will charge the customer the unpaid amount for the prorated period up to the end of the current period.
- `charge_custom`: Will charge the customer a custom amount.
- `refund_prorata`: Will refund to the customer the overpaid subscription amount using prorated calculations on the cancellation date.
- `refund_custom`: Will refund to the customer a custom amount.
- `end_of_period`: Will cancel the subscription at the end date of the current billing period.
- `do_nothing`: Will only cease the subscription without any additional actions.

cancellation_amount.description: Custom amount used when cancelling the subscription. Only applies to the `charge_custom` or the `refund_custom` cancellation strategy.

cancellation_refund_method.description: Override the refund destination for credit notes generated by `refund_prorata` / `refund_custom` cancellation strategies. When omitted, falls back to the invoicing entity's `creditNoteWalletRefundEnabled` setting.

properties.description: Key/value pairs to store any metadata useful in your context.

anyOf.description: UTC date time string in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

custom_properties.description: A list of key value with the slug of the custom property as the key and the custom property value as value.

tax_only.description: Only tax will be charged on this subscription.

generate_draft_invoices.description: Generate draft invoices for the subscription. Each invoice will need to be reviewed and validated manually before being sent

generate_document.description: Generate non-legal documents instead of invoices.

document_name.description: If `generate_document` is turned on, allows you to give a name to your document.

add_tax_to_document.description: If `generate_document` is turned on, will add taxes to document.

do_not_charge_subscription.description: Subscription will be invoiced but not charged (invoices/documents will be settled directly).

invoice_custom_note.description: Default custom note added to invoices generated by the subscription.

invoice_schedule.description:
Defines when invoices are generated relative to the billing period.

- `period_start`: Invoices are generated at the start of the billing period.
- `period_end`: Invoices are generated at the end of the billing period.

type.description:
Type of subscription phase.

- `setup`: The phase represents a non-recurring service setup period, often used before the actual recurring subscription begins.
- `trial`: The phase represents a non-recurring trial period, often used to allow users to opt out or experience a free test.
- `standard`: The phase represents a standard recurring billing.

status.description:
Status of subscription phase.

- `pending`: The phase is waiting to start (not started yet).
- `active`: The phase is currently in progress.
- `finished`: The phase has ended and is complete.

order.description: Order in which the phase is executed within all subscription phases.

end_strategy.description:
End strategy of subscription phase.

- `manual`: The phase ends when a user manually stops it.
- `end_date`: The phase ends on a specified date.
- `duration`: The phase ends after a specific relative duration.
- `contract_end_date`: The phase ends on the end date of the related subscription contract.

duration.description: Interval over which the subscription phase spans. Only applies to `duration` end strategy.

billing_date_setting.description:
Represents when the first billing date occurs.

- `phase_start`: Aligns with the start of the phase.
- `specific_date`: Occurs on a specified date.

initial_billing_at.description: Date when the subscription phase will start being billed. Only applies to `specific_date` billing date setting. UTC date time string in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

starts_at.description: Actual start date of the phase. UTC date time string in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

ends_at.description: Actual end date of the phase. UTC date time string in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

billing_cycle_alignment.description:
Alignment of product billing cycles. If omitted at creation, the billing cycles alignment configured in the account subscription settings applies.

- `calendar_period`: The billing cycles of the products will be aligned on the calendar period, after the first period which will be invoiced taking into account the prorata of the first cycle compared to the product periodicity.
- `anniversary`: The billing cycles of the products will be aligned on the anniversary of the phase initial billing date.

do_not_invoice_phase.description: Indicates if the phase should be invoiced. If set to true, the phase will not generate any invoices.

transition_calculation_method.description:
Calculation method used when transitioning from one phase to the next one.

- `prorata`: The prorated amount between the two phases relative to the end date (the transition date) must be paid.
- `pay_in_full`: The full amount for the phase billing period must be paid.
- `none`: No amount will need to be paid, phase will simply transition from one to the next.

transition_invoicing_schedule.description:
Represents when the transition amount will be invoiced.

- `immediately`: An invoice will be generated immediately with the corresponding amount.

description_display_interval_dates.description: Indicates if the dates of the interval should be automatically added in the product description on the invoices.

payment_schedule.description: Indicates if the product should be billed at the start or the end of the payment interval.

prices.description: Prices of the product. If not specified, the matching prices (depending on the currency, interval, etc) of the product defined in the products catalog/plan are used.

count.description: Number of product units. Only applies to products of type `flat_fee`, `seat` or `credit`.

unit_name.description: Product name. This will appear on the final invoices. Only applies to products of type `seat` or `usage`.

min_committed_count.description: Minimum of units committed. If usage is less than this number, then this value will be used. Only applies to products of type `usage`.

min_amount.description: Minimum amount billed. If the final computed amount from the usage for this product is less than this amount, then this value will be used. Only applies to products of type `usage`.

max_amount.description: Maximum amount billed. If the final computed amount from the usage for this product is greater than this amount, then this value will be used. Only applies to products of type `usage`.

charging_method.description:
Charging method for seat count updates within the current billing period. Only applies to connected seat products.

- `prorata`: Price calculated proportionally to time elapsed in the billing period.
- `pay_in_full`: Price calculated for the entire billing period.
- `do_not_charge`: No charge for the update.

seat_invoicing_schedule.description:
Policy defining when seat count changes are invoiced. Only applies to connected seat products.

- `immediately`: Seat changes are invoiced immediately.
- `next_invoice`: Seat changes are invoiced at the next invoice.
- `custom`: Seat changes are invoiced on a custom schedule.

metering_interval_type.description:
Indicates on which type of interval the usage should be aggregated.

- `subscription_commitment`: For the usage contained within the subscription commitment period.
- `payment_interval`: For the usage contained within the payment interval of the product.
- `full_database`: For all the usage we ingested for this product, no matter the period.
- `phase_duration`: For the usage contained within the subscription phase.
- `custom`: For the usage contained within a custom interval that starts with the phase and renews independently of the billing interval. Requires `metering_interval` to be set.
   Only applies to products of type `usage`.

metering_interval.description: Custom interval for usage aggregation. Required when `metering_interval_type` is `custom`. The interval starts at the phase start and renews on its own cycle (e.g. `{ period: 'months', count: 3 }` for quarterly metering with monthly billing). Only applies to products of type `usage`.

bill_usage_difference.description: Only bill the usage difference comparing to the previous period (i.e. actual amount minus last invoice amount). Doesn't apply to `payment_interval` metering interval type. Only applies to products of type `usage`.

children_usage_aggregation.description:
Controls whether a parent organization's metered usage is billed on the combined usage of the parent and its direct children, and how per-member values are combined.

- `null`: Organization-based usage is disabled. Only the subscription customer's own usage is billed.
- `sum`: The usage values of the parent and each direct child are added together (organization total).
- `max`: Only the single highest-consuming member (parent or one direct child) is billed.
 Only applies to products of type `usage`. Not compatible with BPS prices.

credits_expiration_in_days.description: Validity in days for credits that will be topped-up automatically. Once the period has passed, they'll expire.

expire_credits_at_end_of_period.description: Automatically set the expiration date to the end of the next period for each topup. Takes priority on `creditsExpirationInDays`

discount_amount.description: Coupon discount amount. Expressed in currency's smallest unit.

repeat.description:
Coupon frequency. Required for inline coupons. Optional when an existing coupon `id` is provided: if omitted, defaults to the catalog coupon's repeat value.

- `once`: Will apply the coupon only to the first one invoice.
- `forever`: Will apply the coupon to all invoices.
- `custom`: Will apply to coupon until a specified expiration date.
- `duration`: Will apply the coupon for a specific duration (e.g., 3 months).

duration_period.description: Period of time for which the coupon will be applied. Only applies to the `duration` coupon frequency.

duration_count.description: Number of periods for which the coupon will be applied. Only applies to the `duration` coupon frequency.

expires_at.description: Coupon expiration date. Only applies to the `custom` coupon frequency. UTC date time string in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

apply_at.description: Coupon first application date. UTC date time string in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

product_ids.description: Product IDs to which the coupon will be applied, or null if applies to all products.

activation_strategy.description:
Activation strategy of subscription phase.

- `immediately`: The phase starts as soon as the subscription is activated.
- `manual`: The phase starts when a user manually activates it.
- `start_date`: The phase starts on a specified date.
- `quote_signature`: The phase starts when the subscription quote is signed.
- `checkout`: The phase starts when the subscription checkout is completed.
- `contract_start_date`: The phase starts on the start date of the related subscription contract.
- `previous_phase_end`: The phase starts when the previous phase ends.

Strategy used to activate the subscription.

- `start_date`: The subscription will become active on the specified start date. If the start date is in the past, it will be activated immediately.
- `manually`: The subscription requires activation through a manual action.
- `checkout`: The subscription will be activated once the checkout is completed, but only if the start date is in the past. Otherwise, activation will occur later on the specified start date.
- `quote`: The subscription will be activated depending on the configuration and the signature of the related quote.

prices.description: Prices of the product. If not specified, the matching prices (depending on the currency, interval, etc) of the product defined in the products catalog/plan are used.

count.description: Number of product units. Only applies to products of type `flat_fee`, `seat` or `credit`.

unit_name.description: Product name. This will appear on the final invoices. Only applies to products of type `seat` or `usage`.

min_committed_count.description: Minimum of units committed. If usage is less than this number, then this value will be used. Only applies to products of type `usage`.

min_amount.description: Minimum amount billed. If the final computed amount from the usage for this product is less than this amount, then this value will be used. Only applies to products of type `usage`.

max_amount.description: Maximum amount billed. If the final computed amount from the usage for this product is greater than this amount, then this value will be used. Only applies to products of type `usage`.

charging_method.description:
Charging method for seat count updates within the current billing period. Only applies to connected seat products.

- `prorata`: Price calculated proportionally to time elapsed in the billing period.
- `pay_in_full`: Price calculated for the entire billing period.
- `do_not_charge`: No charge for the update.

seat_invoicing_schedule.description:
Policy defining when seat count changes are invoiced. Only applies to connected seat products.

- `immediately`: Seat changes are invoiced immediately.
- `next_invoice`: Seat changes are invoiced at the next invoice.
- `custom`: Seat changes are invoiced on a custom schedule.

metering_interval_type.description:
Indicates on which type of interval the usage should be aggregated.

- `subscription_commitment`: For the usage contained within the subscription commitment period.
- `payment_interval`: For the usage contained within the payment interval of the product.
- `full_database`: For all the usage we ingested for this product, no matter the period.
- `phase_duration`: For the usage contained within the subscription phase.
- `custom`: For the usage contained within a custom interval that starts with the phase and renews independently of the billing interval. Requires `metering_interval` to be set.
   Only applies to products of type `usage`.

metering_interval.description: Custom interval for usage aggregation. Required when `metering_interval_type` is `custom`. The interval starts at the phase start and renews on its own cycle (e.g. `{ period: 'months', count: 3 }` for quarterly metering with monthly billing). Only applies to products of type `usage`.

bill_usage_difference.description: Only bill the usage difference comparing to the previous period (i.e. actual amount minus last invoice amount). Doesn't apply to `payment_interval` metering interval type. Only applies to products of type `usage`.

children_usage_aggregation.description:
Controls whether a parent organization's metered usage is billed on the combined usage of the parent and its direct children, and how per-member values are combined.

- `null`: Organization-based usage is disabled. Only the subscription customer's own usage is billed.
- `sum`: The usage values of the parent and each direct child are added together (organization total).
- `max`: Only the single highest-consuming member (parent or one direct child) is billed.
 Only applies to products of type `usage`. Not compatible with BPS prices.

credits_expiration_in_days.description: Validity in days for credits that will be topped-up automatically. Once the period has passed, they'll expire.

expire_credits_at_end_of_period.description: Automatically set the expiration date to the end of the next period for each topup. Takes priority on `creditsExpirationInDays`

products.description: Products that make up the subscription.

discount_amount.description: Coupon discount amount. Expressed in currency's smallest unit.

repeat.description:
Coupon frequency. Required for inline coupons. Optional when an existing coupon `id` is provided: if omitted, defaults to the catalog coupon's repeat value.

- `once`: Will apply the coupon only to the first one invoice.
- `forever`: Will apply the coupon to all invoices.
- `custom`: Will apply to coupon until a specified expiration date.
- `duration`: Will apply the coupon for a specific duration (e.g., 3 months).

duration_period.description: Period of time for which the coupon will be applied. Only applies to the `duration` coupon frequency.

duration_count.description: Number of periods for which the coupon will be applied. Only applies to the `duration` coupon frequency.

expires_at.description: Coupon expiration date. Only applies to the `custom` coupon frequency. UTC date time string in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

apply_at.description: Coupon first application date. UTC date time string in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

product_ids.description: Product IDs to which the coupon will be applied, or null if applies to all products.

coupons.description: Coupons to be applied to the prices of subscription products.

end_strategy.description: Defines how the free trial will end.

starts_at.description: Free trial start date. UTC date time string in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

ends_at.description: Free trial end date. Only applies if the end strategy is `end_date`. UTC date time string in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

period.description: Free trial duration period. Only applies if the end strategy is `duration`.

count.description: Free trial duration count. Only applies if the end strategy is `duration`.

trial.description: Create a free trial phase based on the plan configuration. Only applies if a `plan_id` is provided.

expires_at.description: Quote expiration date. UTC date time string in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

invoicing_entity_id.description: ID of the invoicing entity attached to the subscription. If not defined, fallback to customer's invoicing entity.

crm_opportunity_id.description: ID of the related opportunity/deal in the connected CRM.

commitment_interval.description: Deprecated field, please use `contract_terms`.

renew_automatically.description: Deprecated field, please use `contract_terms`.

minimum_invoice_fee.description: Minimum fee applied to each invoice outside of one time payments.

starts_at.description: Start date of the contract. UTC date time string in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

ends_at.description: End date of the contract. UTC date time string in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

duration.description: Interval over which the contract initially spans. Only applies to `duration` end strategy.

renew_automatically.description:
Indicates if the contract should be renewed automatically.

- `true`: The contract will be renewed automatically.
- `false`: The contract will not be renewed automatically.

renew_for_duration.description: Interval over which the contract will be renewed. Only applies if `renew_automatically` is true.

activation_strategy.description:
Activation strategy of the contract.

- `immediately`: The contract will be activated immediately.
- `manual`: The contract will be activated when a user manually activates it.
- `start_date`: The contract will be activated on a specified date.
- `quote_signature`: The contract will be activated when the subscription quote is signed.
- `checkout`: The contract will be activated when the subscription checkout is completed.

end_strategy.description:
End strategy of contract.

- `manual`: The contract ends when a user manually stops it.
- `end_date`: The contract ends on a specified date.
- `duration`: The contract ends after a specific relative duration, unless `renew_automatically` is true.

contract_terms.description: Contract terms linked to the subscription.

starts_at.description: Applies only if the activation strategy is `start_date`. UTC date time string in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

initial_billing_at.description: Date when the subscription will start being billed. If not specified, it will correspond to the `starts_at` date. UTC date time string in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

display_shipping_details.description: Indicates if the shipping details should be displayed on the subscription's invoices.

cancel_at.description: Subscription cancel date. UTC date time string in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

cancellation_strategy.description:
Strategy used to cancel the subscription. If not specified `do_nothing` is used.

- `charge_prorata`: Will charge the customer the unpaid amount for the prorated period up to the end of the current period.
- `charge_custom`: Will charge the customer a custom amount.
- `refund_prorata`: Will refund to the customer the overpaid subscription amount using prorated calculations on the cancellation date.
- `refund_custom`: Will refund to the customer a custom amount.
- `end_of_period`: Will cancel the subscription at the end date of the current billing period.
- `do_nothing`: Will only cease the subscription without any additional actions.

cancellation_amount.description: Custom amount used when cancelling the subscription. Only applies to the `charge_custom` or the `refund_custom` cancellation strategy.

cancellation_refund_method.description: Override the refund destination for credit notes generated by `refund_prorata` / `refund_custom` cancellation strategies. When omitted, falls back to the invoicing entity's `creditNoteWalletRefundEnabled` setting.

properties.description: Key/value pairs to store any metadata useful in your context.

anyOf.description: UTC date time string in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

custom_properties.description: A list of key value with the slug of the custom property as the key and the custom property value as value.

tax_only.description: Only tax will be charged on this subscription.

generate_draft_invoices.description: Generate draft invoices for the subscription. Each invoice will need to be reviewed and validated manually before being sent

generate_document.description: Generate non-legal documents instead of invoices.

document_name.description: If `generate_document` is turned on, allows you to give a name to your document.

add_tax_to_document.description: If `generate_document` is turned on, will add taxes to document.

do_not_charge_subscription.description: Subscription will be invoiced but not charged (invoices/documents will be settled directly).

invoice_custom_note.description: Default custom note added to invoices generated by the subscription.

invoice_schedule.description:
Defines when invoices are generated relative to the billing period.

- `period_start`: Invoices are generated at the start of the billing period.
- `period_end`: Invoices are generated at the end of the billing period.

type.description:
Type of subscription phase.

- `setup`: The phase represents a non-recurring service setup period, often used before the actual recurring subscription begins.
- `trial`: The phase represents a non-recurring trial period, often used to allow users to opt out or experience a free test.
- `standard`: The phase represents a standard recurring billing.

status.description:
Status of subscription phase.

- `pending`: The phase is waiting to start (not started yet).
- `active`: The phase is currently in progress.
- `finished`: The phase has ended and is complete.

order.description: Order in which the phase is executed within all subscription phases.

end_strategy.description:
End strategy of subscription phase.

- `manual`: The phase ends when a user manually stops it.
- `end_date`: The phase ends on a specified date.
- `duration`: The phase ends after a specific relative duration.
- `contract_end_date`: The phase ends on the end date of the related subscription contract.

duration.description: Interval over which the subscription phase spans. Only applies to `duration` end strategy.

billing_date_setting.description:
Represents when the first billing date occurs.

- `phase_start`: Aligns with the start of the phase.
- `specific_date`: Occurs on a specified date.

initial_billing_at.description: Date when the subscription phase will start being billed. Only applies to `specific_date` billing date setting. UTC date time string in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

starts_at.description: Actual start date of the phase. UTC date time string in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

ends_at.description: Actual end date of the phase. UTC date time string in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

billing_cycle_alignment.description:
Alignment of product billing cycles. If omitted at creation, the billing cycles alignment configured in the account subscription settings applies.

- `calendar_period`: The billing cycles of the products will be aligned on the calendar period, after the first period which will be invoiced taking into account the prorata of the first cycle compared to the product periodicity.
- `anniversary`: The billing cycles of the products will be aligned on the anniversary of the phase initial billing date.

do_not_invoice_phase.description: Indicates if the phase should be invoiced. If set to true, the phase will not generate any invoices.

transition_calculation_method.description:
Calculation method used when transitioning from one phase to the next one.

- `prorata`: The prorated amount between the two phases relative to the end date (the transition date) must be paid.
- `pay_in_full`: The full amount for the phase billing period must be paid.
- `none`: No amount will need to be paid, phase will simply transition from one to the next.

transition_invoicing_schedule.description:
Represents when the transition amount will be invoiced.

- `immediately`: An invoice will be generated immediately with the corresponding amount.

name.description: Product name. This will appear on the final invoices.

description.description: Product description. This will appear on the final invoices.

description_display_interval_dates.description: Indicates if the dates of the interval should be automatically added in the product description on the invoices.

payment_interval.description: Interval on which the product is billed. This interval can be different between products and can differ from the subscription commitment interval.

payment_schedule.description: Indicates if the product should be billed at the start or the end of the payment interval.

amount.description: Monetary amount. Expressed in currency's smallest unit.

price.description: Similar to `prices`, allow to apply a single fee price more easily.

amount.description: Monetary amount. Expressed in currency's smallest unit.
Monetary amount of the price for the number of units defined by `unit_count`. Expressed in currency's smallest unit.

unit_count.description: Number of units considered for the amount.

on_tier_incomplete.description:
Logic used to compute the amount when usage on the tier is incomplete.

- `pro_rata`: The amount is computed using the pro rata of the tier's consumption.
- `pay_in_full`: The amount corresponds to the full payment of the tier.
- `do_not_charge`: The tier is not charged and ignored.

allOf.description: Metering filter that scopes which billable events are eligible for this price tier. Only present when the price is filtered.

amount.description: Monetary amount of the price for the number of units defined by `unit_count`. Expressed in currency's smallest unit.

unit_count.description: Number of units considered for the amount.

on_bucket_incomplete.description:
Logic used to compute the amount when usage reaches an incomplete bucket (the bucket size corresponds to the `unitCount`).

  - `pro_rata`: The amount is computed using the pro rata of the bucket's consumption.
  - `pay_in_full`: The amount corresponds to the full payment of the bucket.
  - `do_not_charge`: The bucket is not charged and ignored.

allOf.description: Metering filter that scopes which billable events are eligible for this price tier. Only present when the price is filtered.

amount.description: Monetary amount of the price for the number of units defined by `unit_count`. Expressed in currency's smallest unit.

unit_count.description: Number of units considered for the amount.

on_tier_incomplete.description:
Logic used to compute the amount when usage on the tier is incomplete.

- `pro_rata`: The amount is computed using the pro rata of the tier's consumption.
- `pay_in_full`: The amount corresponds to the full payment of the tier.
- `do_not_charge`: The tier is not charged and ignored.

allOf.description: Metering filter that scopes which billable events are eligible for this price tier. Only present when the price is filtered.

percentage.description: Percentage applied on each unit to compute the usage.

per_unit_cap.description: Maximum amount for one unit. Expressed in currency's smallest unit.

per_unit_floor.description: Minimum amount for one unit. Expressed in currency's smallest unit.

per_unit_fee.description: Fee amount applied per unit. Expressed in currency's smallest unit.

allOf.description: Metering filter that scopes which billable events are eligible for this price tier. Only present when the price is filtered.

amount.description: Monetary amount of the price for the number of units defined by `unit_count`. Expressed in currency's smallest unit.

unit_count.description: Number of units considered for the amount.

- `quote_signature`: The phase starts when the subscription quote is signed.
- `checkout`: The phase starts when the subscription checkout is completed.
- `contract_start_date`: The phase starts on the start date of the related subscription contract.
- `previous_phase_end`: The phase starts when the previous phase ends.

Strategy used to activate the subscription.

- `start_date`: The subscription will become active on the specified start date. If the start date is in the past, it will be activated immediately.
- `manually`: The subscription requires activation through a manual action.
- `checkout`: The subscription will be activated once the checkout is completed, but only if the start date is in the past. Otherwise, activation will occur later on the specified start date.
- `quote`: The subscription will be activated depending on the configuration and the signature of the related quote.

requestBody.description:
Update quote payload.

This endpoint updates quote-level fields before a quote is finalized. On draft quotes, pass `subscription` to create or replace the draft subscription configuration attached to the quote, or pass `invoice` on a one-off quote to delete the previous draft invoice and create a fresh one linked to the quote. The `subscription` and `invoice` payloads use the same shape as quote creation.

Draft quote subscription configuration must be updated through this endpoint, not `PUT /v2/subscriptions/{subscription_id}`. Keep phase and contract activation strategies compatible with the quote signature flow, such as `quote_signature` for phases that start on quote signature. Do not switch the quote flow to `checkout`, because checkout activation is a separate flow and requires a checkout session.

metering_interval_type.description:
Indicates on which type of interval the usage should be aggregated.

- `subscription_commitment`: For the usage contained within the subscription commitment period.
- `payment_interval`: For the usage contained within the payment interval of the product.
- `full_database`: For all the usage we ingested for this product, no matter the period.
- `phase_duration`: For the usage contained within the subscription phase.
- `custom`: For the usage contained within a custom interval that starts with the phase and renews independently of the billing interval. Requires `metering_interval` to be set.
   Only applies to products of type `usage`.

metering_interval.description: Custom interval for usage aggregation. Required when `metering_interval_type` is `custom`. The interval starts at the phase start and renews on its own cycle (e.g. `{ period: 'months', count: 3 }` for quarterly metering with monthly billing). Only applies to products of type `usage`.

bill_usage_difference.description: Only bill the usage difference comparing to the previous period (i.e. actual amount minus last invoice amount). Doesn't apply to `payment_interval` metering interval type. Only applies to products of type `usage`.

children_usage_aggregation.description:
Controls whether a parent organization's metered usage is billed on the combined usage of the parent and its direct children, and how per-member values are combined.

- `null`: Organization-based usage is disabled. Only the subscription customer's own usage is billed.
- `sum`: The usage values of the parent and each direct child are added together (organization total).
- `max`: Only the single highest-consuming member (parent or one direct child) is billed.
 Only applies to products of type `usage`. Not compatible with BPS prices.

Controls whether a parent organization's metered usage is billed on the combined usage of the parent and its direct children, and how per-member values are combined.

- `null`: Organization-based usage is disabled. Only the subscription customer's own usage is billed.
- `sum`: The usage values of the parent and each direct child are added together (organization total).
- `max`: Only the single highest-consuming member (parent or one direct child) is billed.
 Only applies to products of type `usage`. Not compatible with BPS prices.

credits_expiration_in_days.description: Validity in days for credits that will be topped-up automatically. Once the period has passed, they'll expire.

expire_credits_at_end_of_period.description: Automatically set the expiration date to the end of the next period for each topup. Takes priority on `creditsExpirationInDays`

discount_amount.description: Coupon discount amount. Expressed in currency's smallest unit.

repeat.description:
Coupon frequency. Required for inline coupons. Optional when an existing coupon `id` is provided: if omitted, defaults to the catalog coupon's repeat value.

- `once`: Will apply the coupon only to the first one invoice.
- `forever`: Will apply the coupon to all invoices.
- `custom`: Will apply to coupon until a specified expiration date.
- `duration`: Will apply the coupon for a specific duration (e.g., 3 months).

duration_period.description: Period of time for which the coupon will be applied. Only applies to the `duration` coupon frequency.

duration_count.description: Number of periods for which the coupon will be applied. Only applies to the `duration` coupon frequency.

expires_at.description: Coupon expiration date. Only applies to the `custom` coupon frequency. UTC date time string in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

apply_at.description: Coupon first application date. UTC date time string in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

product_ids.description: Product IDs to which the coupon will be applied, or null if applies to all products.

get.description: Retrieve existing subscriptions. By default, draft, voided, cancelled and archived subscriptions are not included (`status=all` applies the same exclusion) — pass `status=any` to list every status, or `status__in=active,cancelled` to pick the ones you need.

schema.description:
Subscription status filter.

- `active`, `pending`, `paused`, `errored`, `cancelled`, `draft`, `voided`, `archived`: match that status.
- `inactive`: shortcut for `pending` + `paused`.
- `all`: every status except `draft`, `voided`, `cancelled` and `archived` — the same exclusion as omitting the filter.
- `any`: every status, no exclusion.

Use `status__in` with comma-separated values to combine statuses. When the filter is omitted, `draft`, `voided`, `cancelled` and `archived` subscriptions are excluded.

post.description: Submit a subscription transition configured from a subscription, plan, or template. A matching workflow returns it pending approval; otherwise it follows the requested schedule.

source_subscription_id.description: The ID of the subscription to transition from

name.description: An optional name for the transition

calculation_method.description: The calculation method to use for the transition. 'do_not_charge' will not generate any transition invoice. 'pro_rata' will generate a prorated invoice for the remaining period. 'pro_rata_separate_documents' issues a credit note for the current period (the amount invoiced when 'last_renewal', otherwise a prorated cancellation credit) and a separate invoice for the new configuration.

billing_cycle_transition_method.description: The billing cycle transition method to use. 'keep_current_billing_cycle' (the default) keeps the current billing cycle dates; the request is rejected when the phases share no product billing periodicity, as the cycle cannot then be preserved — use 'align_to_new_billing_cycle' in that case. 'align_to_new_billing_cycle' aligns the billing cycle to the transition date.

application_schedule.description: When the transition should be applied: 'immediately', 'scheduled' for a specific date, or 'last_renewal' to apply it retroactively to the start of the current billing period (refunding what was already invoiced for that period and re-charging the new configuration). Past dates within the current billing period are supported and will be applied immediately.

transition_date.description: The date at which the transition should occur. Only applicable if the application schedule is 'scheduled'. Can be a past date within the current billing period. UTC date time string in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

invoicing_entity_id.description: ID of the invoicing entity attached to the subscription. If not defined, fallback to customer's invoicing entity.

crm_opportunity_id.description: ID of the related opportunity/deal in the connected CRM.

commitment_interval.description: Deprecated field, please use `contract_terms`.

minimum_invoice_fee.description: Minimum fee applied to each invoice outside of one time payments.

starts_at.description: Start date of the contract. UTC date time string in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

ends_at.description: End date of the contract. UTC date time string in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

duration.description: Interval over which the contract initially spans. Only applies to `duration` end strategy.

renew_automatically.description:
Indicates if the contract should be renewed automatically.

- `true`: The contract will be renewed automatically.
- `false`: The contract will not be renewed automatically.

renew_for_duration.description: Interval over which the contract will be renewed. Only applies if `renew_automatically` is true.

activation_strategy.description:
Activation strategy of the contract.

- `immediately`: The contract will be activated immediately.
- `manual`: The contract will be activated when a user manually activates it.
- `start_date`: The contract will be activated on a specified date.
- `quote_signature`: The contract will be activated when the subscription quote is signed.
- `checkout`: The contract will be activated when the subscription checkout is completed.

end_strategy.description:
End strategy of contract.

- `manual`: The contract ends when a user manually stops it.
- `end_date`: The contract ends on a specified date.
- `duration`: The contract ends after a specific relative duration, unless `renew_automatically` is true.

contract_terms.description: Contract terms linked to the subscription.

starts_at.description: Applies only if the activation strategy is `start_date`. UTC date time string in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

initial_billing_at.description: Date when the subscription will start being billed. If not specified, it will correspond to the `starts_at` date. UTC date time string in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

display_shipping_details.description: Indicates if the shipping details should be displayed on the subscription's invoices.

cancel_at.description: Subscription cancel date. UTC date time string in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

cancellation_strategy.description:
Strategy used to cancel the subscription. If not specified `do_nothing` is used.

- `charge_prorata`: Will charge the customer the unpaid amount for the prorated period up to the end of the current period.
- `charge_custom`: Will charge the customer a custom amount.
- `refund_prorata`: Will refund to the customer the overpaid subscription amount using prorated calculations on the cancellation date.
- `refund_custom`: Will refund to the customer a custom amount.
- `end_of_period`: Will cancel the subscription at the end date of the current billing period.
- `do_nothing`: Will only cease the subscription without any additional actions.

cancellation_amount.description: Custom amount used when cancelling the subscription. Only applies to the `charge_custom` or the `refund_custom` cancellation strategy.

cancellation_refund_method.description: Override the refund destination for credit notes generated by `refund_prorata` / `refund_custom` cancellation strategies. When omitted, falls back to the invoicing entity's `creditNoteWalletRefundEnabled` setting.

properties.description: Key/value pairs to store any metadata useful in your context.

anyOf.description: UTC date time string in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

custom_properties.description: A list of key value with the slug of the custom property as the key and the custom property value as value.

tax_only.description: Only tax will be charged on this subscription.

generate_draft_invoices.description: Generate draft invoices for the subscription. Each invoice will need to be reviewed and validated manually before being sent

generate_document.description: Generate non-legal documents instead of invoices.

document_name.description: If `generate_document` is turned on, allows you to give a name to your document.

add_tax_to_document.description: If `generate_document` is turned on, will add taxes to document.

do_not_charge_subscription.description: Subscription will be invoiced but not charged (invoices/documents will be settled directly).

invoice_custom_note.description: Default custom note added to invoices generated by the subscription.

invoice_schedule.description:
Defines when invoices are generated relative to the billing period.

- `period_start`: Invoices are generated at the start of the billing period.
- `period_end`: Invoices are generated at the end of the billing period.

plan_id.description: Deprecated field, please use `template_id`.

template_id.description: ID of the template that the subscription is linked to.

template_configuration_id.description: ID of the template configuration that the subscription is linked to.

type.description:
Type of subscription phase.

- `setup`: The phase represents a non-recurring service setup period, often used before the actual recurring subscription begins.
- `trial`: The phase represents a non-recurring trial period, often used to allow users to opt out or experience a free test.
- `standard`: The phase represents a standard recurring billing.

status.description:
Status of subscription phase.

- `pending`: The phase is waiting to start (not started yet).
- `active`: The phase is currently in progress.
- `finished`: The phase has ended and is complete.

order.description: Order in which the phase is executed within all subscription phases.

activation_strategy.description:
Activation strategy of subscription phase.

- `immediately`: The phase starts as soon as the subscription is activated.
- `manual`: The phase starts when a user manually activates it.
- `start_date`: The phase starts on a specified date.
- `quote_signature`: The phase starts when the subscription quote is signed.
- `checkout`: The phase starts when the subscription checkout is completed.
- `contract_start_date`: The phase starts on the start date of the related subscription contract.
- `previous_phase_end`: The phase starts when the previous phase ends.

end_strategy.description:
End strategy of subscription phase.

- `manual`: The phase ends when a user manually stops it.
- `end_date`: The phase ends on a specified date.
- `duration`: The phase ends after a specific relative duration.
- `contract_end_date`: The phase ends on the end date of the related subscription contract.

duration.description: Interval over which the subscription phase spans. Only applies to `duration` end strategy.

billing_date_setting.description:
Represents when the first billing date occurs.

- `phase_start`: Aligns with the start of the phase.
- `specific_date`: Occurs on a specified date.

initial_billing_at.description: Date when the subscription phase will start being billed. Only applies to `specific_date` billing date setting. UTC date time string in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

starts_at.description: Actual start date of the phase. UTC date time string in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

ends_at.description: Actual end date of the phase. UTC date time string in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

billing_cycle_alignment.description:
Alignment of product billing cycles. If omitted at creation, the billing cycles alignment configured in the account subscription settings applies.

- `calendar_period`: The billing cycles of the products will be aligned on the calendar period, after the first period which will be invoiced taking into account the prorata of the first cycle compared to the product periodicity.
- `anniversary`: The billing cycles of the products will be aligned on the anniversary of the phase initial billing date.

do_not_invoice_phase.description: Indicates if the phase should be invoiced. If set to true, the phase will not generate any invoices.

transition_calculation_method.description:
Calculation method used when transitioning from one phase to the next one.

- `prorata`: The prorated amount between the two phases relative to the end date (the transition date) must be paid.
- `pay_in_full`: The full amount for the phase billing period must be paid.
- `none`: No amount will need to be paid, phase will simply transition from one to the next.

transition_invoicing_schedule.description:
Represents when the transition amount will be invoiced.

- `immediately`: An invoice will be generated immediately with the corresponding amount.

name.description: Product name. This will appear on the final invoices.

description.description: Product description. This will appear on the final invoices.

description_display_interval_dates.description: Indicates if the dates of the interval should be automatically added in the product description on the invoices.

payment_interval.description: Interval on which the product is billed. This interval can be different between products and can differ from the subscription commitment interval.

payment_schedule.description: Indicates if the product should be billed at the start or the end of the payment interval.

requestBody.description:
Update subscription payload.

This endpoint supports comprehensive subscription updates including:
- Basic subscription fields (name, purchase order, etc.)
- Phase management: update current phase, create or delete pending phases
- Product management within phases: update quantities, prices, or remove products
- Coupon management within phases

Pending phases will be replaced by the ones provided in the array.

Note: The payload structure matches the response from GET /v2/subscriptions/:id, allowing you to retrieve a subscription, modify it, and update it using the same structure.

Example:
- GET /v2/subscriptions/:id returns phases [A, B, C]
- PUT /v2/subscriptions/:id with phases [A, C] will delete phase B
- PUT /v2/subscriptions/:id with phases [A, B, C, D] will create phase D

Date fields can only be updated before a subscription is active. Other fields can be updated at any time.

When the update matches an approval workflow, the endpoint returns HTTP 202 with the current subscription. The requested update remains pending until approved.

Subscriptions attached to draft quotes cannot have their configuration updated through this endpoint. Use `PATCH /v1/quotes/{id}` with the quote creation `subscription` payload shape instead.

A product's billing periodicity (`payment_interval`) cannot be changed through this endpoint once the phases would share no periodicity at all, because the current billing cycle cannot then be preserved. Use `POST /v2/subscriptions/{id}/transitions` with `billing_cycle_transition_method: "align_to_new_billing_cycle"` and the calculation method you want instead.

- `manual`: The phase starts when a user manually activates it.
- `start_date`: The phase starts on a specified date.
- `quote_signature`: The phase starts when the subscription quote is signed.
- `checkout`: The phase starts when the subscription checkout is completed.
- `contract_start_date`: The phase starts on the start date of the related subscription contract.
- `previous_phase_end`: The phase starts when the previous phase ends.

end_strategy.description:
End strategy of subscription phase.

- `manual`: The phase ends when a user manually stops it.
- `end_date`: The phase ends on a specified date.
- `duration`: The phase ends after a specific relative duration.
- `contract_end_date`: The phase ends on the end date of the related subscription contract.

duration.description: Interval over which the subscription phase spans. Only applies to `duration` end strategy.

billing_date_setting.description:
Represents when the first billing date occurs.

- `phase_start`: Aligns with the start of the phase.
- `specific_date`: Occurs on a specified date.

initial_billing_at.description: Date when the subscription phase will start being billed. Only applies to `specific_date` billing date setting. UTC date time string in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

starts_at.description: Actual start date of the phase. UTC date time string in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

ends_at.description: Actual end date of the phase. UTC date time string in the [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

billing_cycle_alignment.description:
Alignment of product billing cycles. If omitted at creation, the billing cycles alignment configured in the account subscription settings applies.

- `calendar_period`: The billing cycles of the products will be aligned on the calendar period, after the first period which will be invoiced taking into account the prorata of the first cycle compared to the product periodicity.
- `anniversary`: The billing cycles of the products will be aligned on the anniversary of the phase initial billing date.

do_not_invoice_phase.description: Indicates if the phase should be invoiced. If set to true, the phase will not generate any invoices.

transition_calculation_method.description:
Calculation method used when transitioning from one phase to the next one.

- `prorata`: The prorated amount between the two phases relative to the end date (the transition date) must be paid.
- `pay_in_full`: The full amount for the phase billing period must be paid.
- `none`: No amount will need to be paid, phase will simply transition from one to the next.

transition_invoicing_schedule.description:
Represents when the transition amount will be invoiced.

- `immediately`: An invoice will be generated immediately with the corresponding amount.
